fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/beaverdam-campground-and-picnic-area ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'There is a $15.00 per night fee for this campground'; page last updated August 28, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Five pull-through sites; the rest are back-in. Tent pads at most sites.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/beaverdam-campground-and-picnic-area ('The campground has 15 units that will accommodate trailers up to 50 feet. There are five pull-through sites with the remaining designed as back-in sites. Tent pads are available at most sites.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water available during summer months. Restrooms are closed Labor Day through Memorial Day.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/beaverdam-campground-and-picnic-area ('Current Conditions: Water available during summer months', 'Potable water is available at this site', 'Restrooms are closed Labor Day through Memorial Day'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'The campground is typically open the Friday before Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day.' In spring and fall the access road may be muddy or have patchy snow.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/beaverdam-campground-and-picnic-area (General Information; 'Seasons of Use: Open seasonally from Memorial Day through Labor Day, weather dependent'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/beaverdam-campground-and-picnic-area ('Reservations: First come-first served.', 'Restrictions: 16 day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Butte RD) campground in the Fleecer Mountains along Divide Creek, ~17 mi S of Butte: I-15 exit 111 (Feely), then ~6 mi west on gravel Divide Creek Road (FSR 96), suitable for passenger vehicles. Close to motorized loop trails and the Continental Divide Trail. --Claude
summary: Forest Service (Butte RD), first-come. Confirmed $15 (FS page updated 2026-08-28), 15 units to 50 ft with 5 pull-throughs, FCFS, seasonal (Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day). Added summer potable water, 16-day limit. No alert names it. Note trimmed of restated values.
